name: Helium 10 All-in-One Suite
description: The industry-standard software suite for Amazon sellers: Black Box product finder, Cerebro reverse ASIN, and Xray analytics.
fullDescription: Helium 10 is the leading all-in-one software ecosystem for Amazon and Walmart sellers. Trusted by over 1 million entrepreneurs worldwide, it provides enterprise-grade data across every stage of the seller lifecycle—from initial niche validation with Black Box and keyword reverse-lookups with Cerebro, to automated financial analytics and PPC bid management.
features: Black Box product database with billions of verified data points and trend filters
Cerebro reverse ASIN tool to uncover competitors organic and sponsored keywords
Xray browser extension for real-time revenue and sales velocity estimations
Frankenstein and Scribbles for listing optimization and keyword indexation checking
Refund Genie for automated FBA lost inventory reimbursement detection
